entries.zh: 悔；悔改（痛悔前非而改过）。
entries.en: to repent; to be sorry for one's sins and amend.
to repent and come to realise one's error; contrition.
to repent of one's faults.
entries.notes: L 栏「de faltoresca sy.」讹脱不可解，「857」为原书页码；义据 H「悔过」与 R 栏定。

entries.en: to reform; to turn back from wrongdoing.
to repent and reform.
entries.notes: H 栏录作「悛解」，而 R 栏 guài 与第 6、7 条「改」字对音相同，当为「悛改」。

entries.en: to amend; to change one's ways.
to mend one's faults; to correct one's errors.

entries.zh: 苦切（痛切悔恨，心中难受）。
entries.en: to be bitterly grieved; to feel sharp remorse.
entries.notes: 西语 pesalle 即 pesarle（引以为悔），与「苦切」相合；然 R 栏 cǐn 与「苦」音不合，对音存疑。

entries.en: to regret; to go back on what one has said.
entries.notes: H 栏「及悔」当为「反悔」：R fǎn、M huǎn 均指向「反」字。

entries.en: to be ashamed and repentant.

entries.zh: 话说两反（把说过的话反过来再说，反复其言）。
entries.en: to retract one's words; to say a thing twice over, contradicting what one said before.
entries.notes: H 栏原带〔疑〕，R 栏 hūn chǔ 与「话」「咀」音不合；义据 L 栏「de lo que antes dixo」定。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H 栏空、R 栏残，L 栏本身亦作「Ab[残]ar」；仅 M 栏 chiō̃ 及 L 栏 arriba/trimarse 略指向船务收帆上风之义，未敢定夺。

entries.en: to lean on; to lean against.
entries.notes: L 栏空缺，据 H、M、R 三栏一致，定为本节 arrimarse 之「倚」。

entries.en: to lean against the wall.

entries.zh: 倚赖（依赖、仰仗在上者之恩庇）。
entries.en: to rely on; to lean upon a patron's favour.
entries.notes: L 栏「fabro de R.o」疑为「favor de R.o（王上之恩）」之讹，R.o 指王室。

entries.en: to attach oneself to; to join.

entries.zh: 附会（亲近依附，结为友朋）。
entries.en: to become attached to; to make friends with.

entries.zh: 依（归依、依靠；此条指归依天主）。
entries.en: to rely on; to take refuge in God.
entries.notes: L 栏「hio」疑为「Dio(s)」之讹，故以归依天主为释。

entries.en: to keep close company with another; to side with someone.
entries.notes: R 栏 hiā 与「侠」音不合，义仅据 L 栏「con otro」与 M 栏 hiap 定。

entries.en: (of a ship) to put in; to come alongside and moor.
entries.notes: L 栏「a cinca」讹脱，M 栏另出 chȳ 一读未详，义据「泊」字定。

entries.zh: 叠（把房屋依次接盖在一处）。
entries.en: to build houses up against one another.

entries.zh: 叠做葩（成簇成串地叠接起来）。
entries.en: to stack up in a cluster; to pile up in rows.
entries.notes: 「葩」字于此费解，仅据 L 栏「vnas casas otras」与 M 音推为成簇叠接。

entries.en: to put together; to stack in one place.
to line up in a row; to join in series.

entries.zh: 重重（一层层相叠、重重相随）。
entries.en: layer upon layer; in repeated tiers.
entries.notes: L 栏「a ocblano」不可解，H 栏原带〔疑〕，义据「重重」及 L 栏「acompañando」定。
